sources.title: Dreamtime Stories
sources.author: Aboriginal Australians
sources.excerpt: In the beginning the earth was a bare plain. There was no life, no death. The sun, the moon, and the stars slept beneath the earth.
sources.longExcerpt: In the beginning the earth was a bare plain. There was no life, no death. The sun, the moon, and the stars slept beneath the earth. This historical source from -40000 provides valuable insight into the oceania region during the antiquity period. It represents the voices, experiences, and perspectives of people who lived during this transformative time in human history. Such primary sources are essential for understanding not just the major events of history, but the daily lives, beliefs, and struggles of ordinary people across different cultures and time periods.

sources.title: The Kumulipo
sources.author: Hawaiian priests
sources.excerpt: At the time when the earth became hot, at the time when the heavens turned about, at the time when the sun was darkened to cause the moon to shine, the time of the rise of the Pleiades, the slime was the source of the earth.
sources.longExcerpt: At the time when the earth became hot, at the time when the heavens turned about, at the time when the sun was darkened to cause the moon to shine, the time of the rise of the Pleiades, the slime was the source of the earth. This Hawaiian creation chant, composed around 1700 for a royal birth, traces genealogy back to the origins of the universe, demonstrating sophisticated astronomical knowledge.
